# Book Isle Tutorials: EPUB, NAS and Calibre

> Begin with local ebooks, reading layout and notes, then connect WebDAV, SMB, OPDS or Calibre and check reading-data sync.

## App and version

- [Book Isle: Ebook Reader for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/nasbook/index.md): Learn about Book Isle local imports, WebDAV, SMB, OPDS, Calibre, notes and reading-data sync through a 60-tutorial learning path.
Version listed: 1.1.3; checked 2026-10-27; iOS 15.6+ / iPadOS 15.6+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Book Isle getting started: import your first EPUB and resume reading](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-getting-started/index.md): Import a local EPUB, jump between chapters, save your position and check offline access, without mistaking a remote cover for downloaded text. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [2. Book Isle EPUB layout: find a comfortable density for long novels](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-epub-typesetting/index.md): Compare font size, typeface, background and orientation within the same chapter, establish a comfortable layout and understand page-number changes after reflow. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [3. Read TXT in Book Isle: check encoding, chapter detection and contents links](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-txt-encoding-chapters/index.md): Distinguish encoding corruption from chapter-detection problems, prepare a UTF-8 copy with consistent headings, and check import, contents and resume position. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [4. Read PDFs in Book Isle: find information with pages, contents and search](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-pdf-navigation-search/index.md): Use PDF page numbers, embedded contents and text search, distinguishing file pages from printed numbers and scanned images from a text layer. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [5. Read documents in Book Isle: organise Markdown, HTML and Office files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-document-reading/index.md): Import Markdown, HTML, RTF and DOCX as personal reading material, check text, external images and layout limits, then organise a searchable document shelf. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [6. Book Isle metadata: organise titles, authors, series and covers](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-metadata-editing/index.md): Check titles, authors, series and covers through individual books and small batches, avoiding accidental merging of different editions with the same title. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [7. Book Isle categories: plan reading with tags, status and ratings](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-tags-status-rating/index.md): Distinguish topic tags, reading status and personal ratings, establish rules with six books, then organise shelves through combined filters and small batch actions. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [8. Book Isle duplicate imports: handle EPUB and PDF versions of one book](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-multiple-formats/index.md): Distinguish duplicates from multiple formats in import previews, verify primary and alternate EPUB or PDF formats, and keep different editions and reading positions separate. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [9. Book Isle full-text search: find a book and position from a phrase](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-full-text-search/index.md): Test book, text and note searches with a known phrase, narrow the scope step by step, and distinguish unavailable downloads, index preparation and scanned-image limits. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [10. Book Isle excerpts: keep highlights and notes, then make a quote card](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-notes-quote-cards/index.md): Select original text, save highlights and personal notes, check quote-card wording and attribution, then share or save an image of the result. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [11. Connect Book Isle to WebDAV: download a book from a private library](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-webdav-library/index.md): Set up a private WebDAV library, check address, path and permissions, download one ebook and verify offline reading, separating library access from reading-data sync. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [12. Connect Book Isle to SMB: browse NAS ebooks on a home network](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-smb-library/index.md): Enter the SMB server, share name and internal path separately, then check folder access, one-book download and the limits of local-network and offline availability. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [13. Connect Book Isle to OPDS: browse, search and acquire ebooks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-opds-library/index.md): Find the real OPDS catalogue URL, browse and search, choose a readable format to download, and troubleshoot working catalogues with broken acquisition links. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [14. Connect Book Isle to Calibre Content Server: read your computer library on iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-calibre-server/index.md): Configure Calibre Content Server, distinguish catalogue-metadata sync from actual downloads, and check computer sleep, permissions and offline-reading limits. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [15. Read a Calibre database in Book Isle: metadata.db and book paths](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-calibre-database/index.md): Access Calibre metadata.db through a NAS, understand the database, library root and relative book paths, and avoid successful catalogue sync with inaccessible book downloads. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [16. Book Isle WebDAV sync: continue reading records across two devices](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-webdav-sync/index.md): Use two devices and a test note to verify two-way updates, distinguish reading-data sync from original-book downloads, and resolve conflicts using clear evidence. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [17. Book Isle audiobooks: import audio and check listening progress](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-audiobook-reading/index.md): Use a short audio file to check import, time position, chapter order and resume. Try speed and timer controls where available and verify which files are offline. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [18. Book Isle reading statistics: review a week and set a sustainable goal](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-reading-statistics/index.md): Check a week’s time range and effort by book, set sustainable reading goals and reminders, then review exported records. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [19. Book Isle app lock: protect the shelf and check unlocking](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-app-lock/index.md): Enable and test app lock, understand system authentication, failed attempts and disabling, and distinguish app-access protection from exported-file and NAS permissions. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [20. Export Book Isle reading data: keep notes, highlights and statistics](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-reading-data-export/index.md): Export notes, highlights and reading statistics as Markdown or CSV, verify the save location and contents, and distinguish readable archives from a complete restorable backup. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [21. Book Isle batch import: move an old collection with a clear audit trail](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-batch-import-audit/index.md): Import old books in small batches, check duplicates and actual text, and keep a list of missing or unreadable files. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [22. Book Isle travel reading pack: prepare books, documents and notes offline](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-offline-travel-pack/index.md): Prepare a small travel collection and verify offline reopening, chapter access and notes while retaining original files. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [23. Book Isle between phone and iPad: two layouts for the same chapter](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-phone-tablet-layout/index.md): Adjust reading density on each screen, verify synced locations by chapter and text, and check notes after layout changes. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [24. Book Isle illustrated EPUB checks: images, notes and contents](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-epub-image-check/index.md): Check chapters, illustrations, footnotes and offline access in an illustrated EPUB, separating missing resources from layout differences. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [25. Book Isle FB2 reading: verify chapters, text and converted copies](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-fb2-reading-check/index.md): Import your own FB2 file, check Chinese text, chapter structure and illustrations, and retain editions and references when conversion is needed. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [26. Read scanned material as CBZ in Book Isle: order and image quality](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-cbz-scan-reading/index.md): Import your own scans as CBZ, check page order, rotation, zoom and locations, and distinguish image reading from text search. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [27. Choose Book Isle conversion formats: prepare a readable companion copy](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-format-conversion-choice/index.md): Choose EPUB, PDF or CBZ for text, fixed pages or images, retain originals and verify the converted edition. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [28. Replace a Book Isle edition: preserve old notes and verify new locations](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-edition-replacement/index.md): Save notes before importing a revised ebook, compare editions through copyright pages and text, and avoid confusing old references with new ones. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [29. Organise a Book Isle series: volumes, titles and reading sequence](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-series-volume-order/index.md): Verify a multi-volume series against actual text and use metadata, display names and a small inventory to keep its order clear. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [30. Book Isle filenames and display titles: keep a route back to originals](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-library-file-naming/index.md): Distinguish filenames, internal metadata and shelf titles, and map authors, editions and sources so original files remain identifiable. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [31. Book Isle topic review: connect key passages across chapters with bookmarks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-bookmark-study-route/index.md): Build a short cross-chapter review route with bookmarks, explanatory notes and an external checklist, then verify the references after layout or device changes. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [32. Book Isle comparative reading: keep two books’ arguments in context](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-comparative-reading-notes/index.md): Compare two authorised ebooks around one question, retain quotations, annotations and edition details, and distinguish disagreements from different assumptions. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [33. Book Isle long quotation cards: check attribution, omissions and line breaks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-quote-card-proofreading/index.md): Turn a longer extract into readable quotation cards while preserving qualifications and attribution, then inspect punctuation, edges and the actual saved image. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [34. Book Isle text search has no results: check scope, wording and extractable text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-search-no-results-check/index.md): Use a visible reference phrase to check edition, search scope, text structure and file availability before interpreting an empty query as missing books or notes. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [35. Book Isle monthly reading review: reconcile statistics, books and notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-monthly-reading-review/index.md): Use one consistent date range to compare reading statistics, completion states, notes and exports, then write a practical personal review for the next month. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [36. Book Isle remote download failures: catalogue, file and reader checks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-remote-download-diagnosis/index.md): Use a small reference file to separate connectivity, permissions, download completion and format reading, and record the failing stage. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [37. Book Isle after a NAS address or folder change: verify the new route](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-server-address-change/index.md): Test changed addresses, ports and shares with a sample, preserve connection records and reading data, and verify library and sync paths separately. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [38. Book Isle after a Calibre library move: keep database and files together](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-calibre-path-repair/index.md): Check metadata.db, directory structure and permissions after moving Calibre, then verify a sample before restoring everyday access. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [39. Book Isle two-device sync handoff: check one change at a time](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-sync-handoff-check/index.md): Verify sync direction with a test note and chapter, preserve valuable records, and distinguish layout and edition differences from transfer problems. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [40. Book Isle new-device checks: restore files, notes and remote access](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-new-device-restore-check/index.md): Inventory books and records while the old device remains usable, verify local reading first, then inspect sync, remote connections and app lock. Originally published: 2026-10-26.
- [41. Book Isle after an interruption: recover context before continuing](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-interrupted-reading-context/index.md): Recover an interrupted argument or story with chapter, bookmark, phrase and pause notes, distinguishing reflowed pagination from a different edition. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [42. Book Isle question-led chapter reading: separate initial questions from final answers](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-question-led-chapter-reading/index.md): Prepare a few answerable questions for one chapter, retain evidence and personal reasoning separately, and verify qualifications before writing sourced answers. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [43. Book Isle character notes: manually track relationships and chapter evidence](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-character-relationship-notes/index.md): Build a small manual record of characters and changing relationships, checking aliases, viewpoint and read scope with source anchors rather than automatic entity mapping. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [44. Book Isle selective anthology reading: choose pieces without overstating completion](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-anthology-selective-reading/index.md): Create a scoped personal reading list for an anthology, verify chapter navigation and references, and keep selected-piece progress separate from whole-book completion. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [45. Book Isle rereading annotations: preserve extracts and date new interpretations](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-rereading-interpretation-log/index.md): Recheck extracts and earlier annotations, then distinguish old interpretation, new evidence and dated revisions while preserving edition and export history. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [46. Check DOCX quality in Book Isle: verify table relationships and footnotes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-docx-tables-footnotes/index.md): Treat a DOCX as an extracted-text reading copy, checking table headers, cells, footnotes and omissions against the original. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [47. Check HTML offline in Book Isle: distinguish text, links and external resources](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-html-offline-links/index.md): Use your own HTML document to verify text, source links and images, then check what remains available offline. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [48. Check two-column PDFs in Book Isle: distinguish page appearance from text order](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-pdf-column-order/index.md): Check visual reading, selection order and search results in a two-column PDF without equating clear display with correct extraction. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [49. Check poetry EPUBs in Book Isle: distinguish verse lines, wrapping and stanza gaps](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-epub-poetry-linebreaks/index.md): Compare intentional verse lines with screen wrapping, checking stanza spacing, indentation and quotation provenance. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [50. Check TXT paragraphs in Book Isle: distinguish hard wraps from paragraph breaks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-txt-hard-linewraps/index.md): Use controlled copies to inspect short lines, blanks and dialogue, retaining the original and reading anchors before external cleanup. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [51. Book Isle shared-library read-only check: verify access with a reader account](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-shared-library-readonly-check/index.md): Check catalogue, download and reading access with an intended shared-library reader account, separating local metadata, server write rights and WebDAV record sync. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [52. Book Isle OPDS catalogue audit: verify metadata, formats and acquired files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-opds-catalog-quality-audit/index.md): Sample known books in an existing OPDS feed, verify attribution, edition and acquisition links, and compare the downloaded contents rather than trusting catalogue matches. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [53. Book Isle remote translated editions: identify the right copy by translator and text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-remote-translated-editions/index.md): Verify translator, edition and representative text across same-title remote books, preserving source and primary-reading identity instead of merging by cover or title. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [54. Book Isle large NAS scans: verify target sections before planning a complete offline copy](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-nas-large-scan-on-demand/index.md): Record target sections, file scale and supported access for large scanned PDF/CBZ material, checking remote reading, complete downloads and storage independently. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [55. Book Isle ebook provenance register: connect originals, editions and access routes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-ebook-source-register/index.md): Create a small provenance and edition inventory distinguishing originals, temporary links, catalogue entries and reading records, then verify later exports and replacements. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [56. Book Isle reference-index checks: trace entries to text and saved notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-reference-index-route/index.md): Use a reference book index to connect entries, page numbers and text, distinguishing indexes, contents and full-text search. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [57. Book Isle figure references: connect numbers, pages and reading notes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-figure-number-notes/index.md): Verify figures against captions and text references, retaining edition and location instead of relying on unlabelled screenshots. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [58. Book Isle quotation checks: trace excerpts to edition and context](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-quotation-source-check/index.md): Before writing or sharing, verify wording, author, translator and context, separating quotations, paraphrases and personal notes. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [59. Book Isle reading-list pruning: retain a next action and defer unsuitable books](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-to-read-pruning/index.md): Review a small unread list against current goals, distinguishing interest, active reading and deferral while preserving files and notes. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
- [60. Book Isle project reference archives: preserve links between books, notes and conclusions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook-project-reference-archive/index.md): At project close, organise reference scope, note purposes and file sources, export readable records and verify a route back to the original text. Originally published: 2026-10-27.
